'''''Champion''''' was a [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]]&ndash;designed [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Evacuees from the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] boarded ''Champion'' to reach the [[Haven (rendezvous point)|Rebel rendezvous point]]. The ship came under attack from the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']] on the way there, but fought off the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] ship.
